description: This file manages SQLite database schema initialization and migration logic for a notes application. It includes functions for connecting to the database, checking and creating tables and indexes, applying schema migrations, and resolving database file paths using a configuration file. The script is designed to be idempotent, debuggable, and capable of forward migrations.

classes.name: DbPaths
classes.description: Represents resolved database file and config paths based on db_connection.txt guidance.

classes.name: MigrationError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when database migrations cannot be safely applied.

methods.name: None _configure_logging()
methods.description: Sets up minimal logging configuration for CLI usage.

methods.name: Optional[DbPaths] _parse_db_connection_txt(connection_txt_path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses db_connection.txt to extract the SQLite database file path.

methods.name: DbPaths resolve_db_path(default_db_name: str = "myapp.db")
methods.description: Resolves the database file path, prioritizing the one specified in db_connection.txt, or falling back to a default.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection _connect(db_file_path: Path)
methods.description: Establishes a SQLite connection with specific PRAGMA settings for this app.

methods.name: int _get_user_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Retrieves the PRAGMA user_version to track schema version.

methods.name: None _set_user_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection, version: int)
methods.description: Sets the PRAGMA user_version to indicate current schema version.

methods.name: bool _table_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists in the database.

methods.name: bool _index_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection, index_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specific index exists in the database.

methods.name: None _ensure_base_tables(conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Creates legacy tables 'app_info' and 'users' if they do not exist.

methods.name: None _seed_app_info(conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Inserts default key-value pairs into 'app_info' table without overwriting existing keys.

methods.name: None _ensure_notes_table_and_indexes(conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Creates the 'notes' table and related indexes and triggers for note storage and efficient querying.

methods.name: None _apply_migration_v1(conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Applies the first migration adding the 'notes' table and indexes.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _apply_migrations(conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Checks current database version and applies any needed migrations to upgrade schema to latest version.

methods.name: DbPaths initialize_and_migrate_sqlite( *, default_db_name: str = "myapp.db", )
methods.description: Public function to initialize the database and apply migrations to bring it to the latest schema version, returning the database paths.
